verdicts.reason: Both candidates have the same problems. The italic subtitle is jammed right up against the left-aligned 'Saturday 21 June' block, which also clashes with the centred headline. The 'Reserve a spot' line sits right next to the grey placeholder box, so they look crowded together. A is worse in two ways: the TASTINGS pill is pushed right with a bigger gap than the other pills, so the spacing is uneven, and the Reserve line is crammed against the legal text with the phone drifting toward the right edge. B keeps the pills evenly spaced, centres the phone better and leaves room between the Reserve line and the footer.
